scope: Closed V21 demand handoff capped at 16 cumulative extents; observed accounting, not an oracle or proven physical residual-byte attribution
semantics: The live runtime closes after 16 total ACKed extents without inspecting the remaining safe checkpoint. This is a cumulative request limit, not a single-burst limit.

Full Host-hit tokens are native request cache accounting captured at first service. Their byte proxy may include coalesced or already-restored prefix ranges and is not exclusively attributed residual physical H2D.

The follow-up permits further missing-prefix bursts within the original two-second ticket lifetime and current native capacity, session/checkpoint and pending-action limits. Each burst still contains at most 16 extents.
No native pipeline dependency or physical receipt verification is removed. Demand handoff remains separate from pre-RETURN predictive H2D.
The fix is not deployed in this closed V21 evidence and has no demonstrated GPU throughput or JCT improvement yet.
